title: Benefits Enrollment
text:
Benefits Enrollment

New hires get a window at the start. After that, changes wait for open enrollment or a qualifying life event such as a birth or a marriage.

title: Benefits Enrollment
text:
Benefits Enrollment

New hires

New hires enroll in benefits within 30 days after the start date.

Missing the new-hire benefits window means waiting for open enrollment unless there is a qualifying life event.

title: Dental and Vision
text:
Dental and Vision

Dental and vision sit beside the medical plan. You can elect them even if you waive medical.

title: Dental and Vision
text:
Dental and Vision

Dental

Acme pays 100% of the employee dental premium.

Acme pays 50% of the dependent dental premium.

The dental annual maximum is $1,500 per person.

title: Dental and Vision
text:
Dental and Vision

Vision

The vision exam allowance is once every 12 months.

The vision frame allowance is $150.

The employee vision premium is $10 per month.

title: Employee Assistance Program
text:
Employee Assistance Program

The EAP is a counseling benefit run by an outside vendor. Acme pays the invoice and does not see the notes.

title: Employee Assistance Program
text:
Employee Assistance Program

Counseling

The employee assistance program includes 6 free counseling sessions per issue.

title: Employee Assistance Program
text:
Employee Assistance Program

Privacy

EAP sessions are confidential and are not reported to the manager.

title: HSA and FSA
text:
HSA and FSA

An HSA and a healthcare FSA are not the same account, and they do not pair with every medical plan. Read the plan name before you elect one.

title: HSA and FSA
text:
HSA and FSA

HSA

The Basic health plan is the HSA-eligible high deductible plan.

Acme contributes $500 to an individual HSA and $1,000 to a family HSA each year.

title: HSA and FSA
text:
HSA and FSA

FSA

The healthcare FSA annual limit at Acme is $3,300.

Plus and Premium health plans can use the healthcare FSA, and the Basic health plan cannot.

title: Learning Stipend
text:
Learning Stipend

Books, courses, and conference tickets that make you better at the job belong here. Team offsites do not.

title: Learning Stipend
text:
Learning Stipend

Amount

The annual learning stipend is $1,500.

title: Learning Stipend
text:
Learning Stipend

Process

Learning stipend requests above $200 are submitted in Workday before the purchase.

title: Life Insurance and Disability
text:
Life Insurance and Disability

Basic life and short-term disability are automatic. Buy-up life is optional and billed through payroll.

title: Life Insurance and Disability
text:
Life Insurance and Disability

Life

Acme provides company-paid life insurance equal to 1 times annual salary.

Employees may buy supplemental life insurance up to 4 times annual salary.

title: Life Insurance and Disability
text:
Life Insurance and Disability

Disability

Short-term disability pays 60% of base pay for up to 12 weeks.

title: Open Enrollment
text:
Open Enrollment

Open enrollment is the annual chance to change medical, dental, vision, and the FSA. Elections lock in when the window closes.

title: Open Enrollment
text:
Open Enrollment

Dates

Open enrollment for 2026 coverage runs from November 1 through November 15, 2025.

title: 401k Retirement Plan
text:
401k Retirement Plan

The 401k is through the company plan. Match is based on eligible pay, and you can change the deferral in the plan site.

title: 401k Retirement Plan
text:
401k Retirement Plan

Match

Acme matches 100% of the first 4% of eligible pay.

Acme matches 50% of the next 2% of eligible pay.

A full company match requires the employee to contribute 6%, and Acme then contributes 5%.

title: 401k Retirement Plan
text:
401k Retirement Plan

Vesting

401k vesting is 25% per year, and the employee is fully vested after 4 years.

title: 401k Retirement Plan
text:
401k Retirement Plan

Enrollment

Employees may enroll in the 401k on day 1.

title: Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends
text:
Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends

Wellness, home internet, and on-call phones are separate stipends. They do not come out of the learning budget.

title: Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends
text:
Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends

Wellness

The monthly wellness stipend is $50.

title: Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends
text:
Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends

Internet

Remote employees receive a home internet stipend of $60 per month.

title: Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends
text:
Wellness, Internet, and Phone Stipends

Phone

On-call employees receive a phone stipend of $40 per month.

title: Corporate Card
text:
Corporate Card

The corporate card is for company spend. It is not a backup personal card that you sort out later.

title: Corporate Card
text:
Corporate Card

Statements

Corporate card statements must be coded in the expense tool by the 5th business day of the next month.

title: Corporate Card
text:
Corporate Card

Personal charges

Personal charges on the corporate card must be repaid within 10 business days.

title: Expense Approval
text:
Expense Approval

The approval chain depends on the amount. Pre-approval and the later expense report are different steps.

title: Expense Approval
text:
Expense Approval

Thresholds

Expenses of $100 or less do not need pre-approval.

Expenses from $100.01 through $1,000 require manager approval.

Directors and Finance both approve an expense above $1,000.

title: Expense Limits Quick Reference
text:
Expense Limits Quick Reference

Duplicate copy of expense-limits. The canonical page is the one with status current and this id. This file exists because the old wiki mirrored policies into a second folder.

Spend company money as if finance will read the receipt out loud. Limits are per person, not per table, unless the line says otherwise.

title: Expense Limits Quick Reference
text:
Expense Limits Quick Reference

Meals

The client dinner expense limit is $75 per person.

The team meal expense limit is $35 per person.

title: Expense Limits Quick Reference
text:
Expense Limits Quick Reference

Travel meals

When per diem is not used, the travel breakfast limit is $20, the travel lunch limit is $30, and the travel dinner limit is $50.

title: Expense Limits Quick Reference
text:
Expense Limits Quick Reference

Receipts

Receipts are required for expenses over $25.

title: Expense Limits Quick Reference
text:
Expense Limits Quick Reference

Alcohol

Alcohol is reimbursable only alongside a customer meal and only inside that cap.

title: Mileage and Ground Transport
text:
Mileage and Ground Transport

Drive your own car only when it is the sensible way to the airport or a customer site. Log miles from the office or from home, whichever is shorter.

title: Mileage and Ground Transport
text:
Mileage and Ground Transport

Mileage

The mileage reimbursement rate is $0.70 per mile.

title: Mileage and Ground Transport
text:
Mileage and Ground Transport

Rideshare

Rideshare trips require a receipt when the fare is over $25.

title: Per Diem Rates
text:
Per Diem Rates

Use these city rates instead of the standard travel meal caps when you are staying overnight. Lodging is a nightly cap before tax.

title: Per Diem Rates
text:
Per Diem Rates

City rates

| City | Lodging per diem | Meals and incidental expenses per diem | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Austin | $180 | $64 | The Austin cap assumes a downtown hotel within walking distance of the headquarters. |
| Denver | $190 | $69 | Denver lodging should be booked near Union Station when the meeting is downtown. |
| New York | $280 | $79 | New York lodging fills early, so the travel desk holds a backup hotel. |
| San Francisco | $270 | $79 | San Francisco lodging near the ferry building is usually at the cap. |
| London | $310 | $90 | London lodging is booked in zone 1 only when the client site is there. |
| Chicago | $220 | $74 | Chicago lodging per diem covers a downtown hotel near the river. |

title: Per Diem Rates
text:
Per Diem Rates

City rates

Read the row that matches the plan or the city. Do not average across rows, and do not use a superseded rate sheet.

title: Travel Policy
text:
Travel Policy

Book the boring option. The travel desk exists so a last-minute fare does not become your problem or finance's.

title: Travel Policy
text:
Travel Policy

Flights

Book flights at least 14 days before departure when the trip is known that far ahead.

title: Travel Policy
text:
Travel Policy

Cabin

Premium economy requires director approval on flights over 6 hours.

title: Travel Policy
text:
Travel Policy

Hotels

Book hotels through the travel desk so the stay stays inside the city lodging per diem.

title: Bereavement and Jury Duty
text:
Bereavement and Jury Duty

These leaves are separate from PTO and sick time. Tell your manager as soon as you can; you do not need to share more detail than you want to.

title: Bereavement and Jury Duty
text:
Bereavement and Jury Duty

Bereavement

Bereavement leave is 5 paid days for an immediate family member.

Bereavement leave is 2 paid days for an extended family member.

title: Bereavement and Jury Duty
text:
Bereavement and Jury Duty

Jury duty

Jury duty is paid for the full duration of the summons.

title: Code of Conduct
text:
Code of Conduct

We work with customers, vendors, and each other. The short version: be honest, skip the gray-area gift, and don't put a friend on a contract.

title: Code of Conduct
text:
Code of Conduct

Gifts

The maximum value of a gift from a vendor is $50.

title: Code of Conduct
text:
Code of Conduct

Conflicts

Employees must disclose a personal relationship with a vendor before any purchasing decision.

title: Code of Conduct
text:
Code of Conduct

Events

A rideshare home from an Acme event with alcohol is reimbursed.

title: Harassment Reporting and Ethics
text:
Harassment Reporting and Ethics

You can report to your manager, to People, or straight to the ethics line. You do not have to have a perfect writeup to start.

title: Harassment Reporting and Ethics
text:
Harassment Reporting and Ethics

Reporting

Report harassment to People or to ethics@acme.example.

The ethics hotline is 1-800-555-0199.

title: Harassment Reporting and Ethics
text:
Harassment Reporting and Ethics

Retaliation

Retaliation for a good-faith report is prohibited.

title: Company Holidays 2024
text:
Company Holidays 2024

Superseded calendar. Kept because a few offer letters from that year still link here. The current holiday list is the 2025 policy.

title: Company Holidays 2024
text:
Company Holidays 2024

Fixed holidays

The day after Thanksgiving is a company holiday in 2024 only on paper and was not observed.

Acme observes 10 fixed company holidays in the old calendar.

title: Company Holidays 2025
text:
Company Holidays 2025

The office is closed on the fixed holidays below. Floating holidays belong to the employee, not the team calendar.

title: Company Holidays 2025
text:
Company Holidays 2025

Fixed holidays

Juneteenth is a company holiday in 2025.

The day after Thanksgiving is a company holiday in 2025.

Acme observes 11 fixed company holidays in 2025.

title: Company Holidays 2025
text:
Company Holidays 2025

Floating holidays

Employees receive 2 floating holidays each calendar year.

Floating holidays must be scheduled in Workday before November 15.

title: Company Holidays 2025
text:
Company Holidays 2025

The closed days

Closed days in the current year include New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr Day, Presidents Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve, and Christmas Day.

title: Internal Transfers
text:
Internal Transfers

Moving teams is normal. Doing it in the first months of a role usually is not, because the team that hired you is still ramping you.

title: Internal Transfers
text:
Internal Transfers

Eligibility

Employees may request an internal transfer after 12 months in the current role.

title: Internal Transfers
text:
Internal Transfers

Process

Internal transfers require a conversation with the current manager and the People partner.

title: Introductory Period
text:
Introductory Period

The first months are for learning the codebase and the customers. They are not a benefits waiting room.

title: Introductory Period
text:
Introductory Period

Timing

The introductory period is 90 days.

title: Introductory Period
text:
Introductory Period

Benefits

Benefits start on day 1, not after the introductory period.

title: Manager Guide to Time Off
text:
Manager Guide to Time Off

Approvals sit with the manager. People Ops watches the queue only when a request has been waiting.

title: Manager Guide to Time Off
text:
Manager Guide to Time Off

Approving requests

Managers approve or decline PTO in Workday within 2 business days.

title: Manager Guide to Time Off
text:
Manager Guide to Time Off

First week

Managers hold a first-week one-on-one within 3 business days of a new hire's start.

title: Parental Leave
text:
Parental Leave

Parental leave is paid and job-protected. Coordinate the dates with your manager early so the team can cover the work, and keep People in the thread.

title: Parental Leave
text:
Parental Leave

Length of leave

The birth parent receives 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

The non-birth parent receives 8 weeks of paid parental leave.

An adoptive parent receives 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

title: Parental Leave
text:
Parental Leave

How to request

Request parental leave in Workday under Time Off, using the Parental Leave type, at least 30 days before the expected start when the timing is foreseeable.

Tell your manager and your HRBP about parental leave.

title: Performance Reviews
text:
Performance Reviews

Reviews are a written record of how the work went, not a surprise. Your manager owes you a draft before the calibration meeting.

title: Performance Reviews
text:
Performance Reviews

Cycle

Performance reviews happen twice a year, in April and October.

title: Performance Reviews
text:
Performance Reviews

Ratings

A performance rating of 3 is defined to mean the employee is meeting expectations.

The performance rating scale runs from 1 to 4.

title: Paid Time Off Policy (2023)
text:
Paid Time Off Policy (2023)

Superseded on December 31, 2024. This page is kept so old links do not 404. Do not use it for a current balance. The questions people still paste into Slack are answered below with the 2023 numbers.

title: Paid Time Off Policy (2023)
text:
Paid Time Off Policy (2023)

Annual allotment

During the first year of service, employees receive 12 PTO days per year.

After 1 year of service, employees receive 12 PTO days per year.

After 3 years of service, employees receive 16 PTO days per year.

After 5 years of service, employees receive 20 PTO days per year.

title: Paid Time Off Policy (2023)
text:
Paid Time Off Policy (2023)

Carryover and accrual

The maximum PTO carryover is 0 days.

title: Paid Time Off Policy (2023)
text:
Paid Time Off Policy (2023)

Questions people still ask

Q: How many PTO days after 3 years? A: 16 PTO days.

Q: What is the maximum PTO carryover? A: 0 days.

Q: How many days a week did office-assigned employees work on site under this era? See the 2023 remote page, not this one.

title: Paid Time Off Policy
text:
Paid Time Off Policy

Paid time off is here so people actually rest. Tenure is measured from the full-time start date, and the current allotment below replaces every earlier intranet page. Managers should plan coverage before they approve a long stretch.

title: Paid Time Off Policy
text:
Paid Time Off Policy

Annual allotment

During the first year of service, employees receive 15 PTO days per year.

After 1 year of service, employees receive 18 PTO days per year.

After 3 years of service, employees receive 22 PTO days per year.

After 5 years of service, employees receive 25 PTO days per year.

title: Paid Time Off Policy
text:
Paid Time Off Policy

Carryover and accrual

The maximum PTO carryover is 5 days.

PTO accrues monthly and is posted on the first of each month.

title: Paid Time Off Policy
text:
Paid Time Off Policy

Requesting time off

Request PTO in Workday at least 5 business days ahead when the request is for 2 or more days.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work (2023)
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work (2023)

Superseded remote policy. The on-site expectation and the stipend changed when the 2025 policy took effect. This copy remains because an old onboarding deck still links to it.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work (2023)
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work (2023)

On-site days

Office-assigned employees work on site 4 days a week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work (2023)
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work (2023)

Home office

The one-time home office stipend is $250.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work

Most roles are hybrid. The pattern below is the default for anyone assigned to an office. Fully remote is an exception with an owner, not a vibe.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work

On-site days

Office-assigned employees work on site 3 days a week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work

Fully remote

Fully remote work is available after 6 months with manager approval.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work

Core hours

Core collaboration hours are 10am to 3pm in the employee's local time zone.

title: Remote and Hybrid Work
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work

Home office

The one-time home office stipend is $500.

title: Sick Leave
text:
Sick Leave

Sick time covers illness and medical appointments. It is not a substitute for PTO and it is not a performance mark when it is used honestly.

title: Sick Leave
text:
Sick Leave

Allotment

Employees receive 10 sick days per year, separate from PTO.

Unused sick days are not paid out and do not carry over.

title: Sick Leave
text:
Sick Leave

Documentation

A doctor's note is required after 3 consecutive sick days.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
text:
Working Hours and Overtime

Full-time work is a week, not a hero streak. Non-exempt teammates must be paid for extra hours, and exempt engineers are still expected to live inside a normal week.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
text:
Working Hours and Overtime

Schedule

Standard full-time hours are 40 hours per week.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
text:
Working Hours and Overtime

Overtime

Non-exempt overtime is paid at 1.5 times the base rate after 40 hours in a week.

Overtime for non-exempt staff must be approved by the manager before it is worked.

title: Working Hours and Overtime
text:
Working Hours and Overtime

Classification

Software engineers at Acme are classified as exempt.

title: First Week Checklist
text:
First Week Checklist

The first week is a checklist, not a vibe. Finish the items that unblock payroll, chat, and the badge before you start a project.

title: First Week Checklist
text:
First Week Checklist

Day 1

On day 1, pick up your badge and laptop from the office front desk or from the shipped kit.

Complete 1Password and Slack setup on day 1.

title: First Week Checklist
text:
First Week Checklist

Manager

Schedule a manager one-on-one within the first 3 business days.

title: IT Support
text:
IT Support

IT can reset a laptop, a badge, and an account. They cannot change a PTO balance.

title: IT Support
text:
IT Support

Contact

IT support email is helpdesk@acme.example.

title: IT Support
text:
IT Support

Slack

Urgent IT help is handled in the Slack channel it-help.

title: IT Support
text:
IT Support

Hours

IT support hours are 8am to 6pm Central Time on business days.

title: Laptop Standard
text:
Laptop Standard

Everyone gets a standard build. Special hardware is for roles that compile or design all day, and it is requested, not assumed.

title: Laptop Standard
text:
Laptop Standard

Standard build

The standard laptop is a 14 inch MacBook Pro or a 14 inch Dell XPS with 32 GB of memory and a 512 GB drive.

title: Laptop Standard
text:
Laptop Standard

Upgrades

Laptop upgrades beyond the standard build require IT approval and a manager note.

title: Laptop Standard
text:
Laptop Standard

Refresh

Laptops are replaced on a 3 year cycle.

title: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication
text:
Passwords and Multifactor Authentication

Passwords live in the company manager. Reuse and short passwords are the two ways accounts actually get popped.

title: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication
text:
Passwords and Multifactor Authentication

Length

Passwords must be at least 14 characters.

title: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication
text:
Passwords and Multifactor Authentication

Manager

Acme uses 1Password as the company password manager.

title: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication
text:
Passwords and Multifactor Authentication

Rotation

Passwords are rotated every 180 days.

title: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication
text:
Passwords and Multifactor Authentication

MFA

Multifactor authentication is required for every company application.

title: Passwords and Multifactor Authentication
text:
Passwords and Multifactor Authentication

Reuse

Employees may not reuse any of their last 8 passwords.

Security Training

Security training is short and mandatory. The phishing drills are practice, and reporting one is the outcome Security wants.

Security Training

Deadline

New hires finish security training within 5 business days after the start date.

title: Security Training
text:
Security Training

Phishing

Phishing drills are run by Security about once a quarter, and reporting a drill is never punished.

title: Software Catalog
text:
Software Catalog

These tools are already licensed. Ask before you put a new vendor on a card.

title: Software Catalog
text:
Software Catalog

Standard tools

The standard software catalog includes Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, GitHub, Figma, 1Password, and Workday.

title: Software Catalog
text:
Software Catalog

Extra software

Extra software with a fee above $200 needs manager approval in the IT portal.

title: VPN Access
text:
VPN Access

The VPN is required off the office network. Do not invent a gateway hostname from an old screenshot.

title: VPN Access
text:
VPN Access

Client

The VPN client is Cisco AnyConnect.

title: VPN Access
text:
VPN Access

Gateway

The VPN gateway hostname is vpn.acme.example.

text:
VPN Access

Access

VPN access requires multifactor authentication.

About Acme

Acme is a mid-size software company. The product helps operations teams move work across tools without a pile of custom scripts.

title: About Acme
text:
About Acme

Company

Acme Co was founded in 2014.

title: About Acme
text:
About Acme

Product

Acme builds Acme Flow, a workflow product for mid-market operations teams.

title: About Acme
text:
About Acme

Size

Acme has about 420 employees.

title: Handbook Glossary
text:
Handbook Glossary

Short definitions for the acronyms the rest of the handbook uses without explaining.

title: Handbook Glossary
text:
Handbook Glossary

Terms

PTO means paid time off.
